name: Kiryuu Mikado
source: Mikado is the leader of REXX. Although he is blunt, he is a reliable person who pays close attention to his surroundings. He prioritizes other people's happiness over his own, and he has a kind heart that he never shows. At home, he also has a domestic side, which includes cooking and doing housework.
